# GlassesResearch

> Independent, evidence-bounded smart-glasses research. Product identity, availability, specifications, hands-on observations, community reports, inferred relationships, hypotheses, disproven claims, and unknowns are kept in distinct evidence lanes.

## Core research

- [Canonical smart-glasses catalog](https://glassesresearch.org/models/THE_LIST/): Stable GLS identifiers and documented purchaser-history admission state.
- [Model research chapters](https://glassesresearch.org/models/): Human-readable model and family investigations.
- [Report Cards](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/REPORT_CARD/): Evidence-bounded evaluation surfaces; unresolved dimensions remain unknown.
- [Evidence library](https://glassesresearch.org/evidence/): Evidence packets, source boundaries, and verification records.
- [Technology lineages](https://glassesresearch.org/lineages/): Model-family and ecosystem research without silent inheritance of specifications or scores.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Open smart-glasses dataset](https://glassesresearch.org/dataset/): Versioned public dataset, schema, checksums, and citation guidance.
- [Canonical models JSON](https://glassesresearch.org/data/public/models.json): Machine-readable canonical model export generated from validated sources.
- [GLS resolver](https://glassesresearch.org/gls/): Resolve stable GlassesResearch model identifiers.
- [Machine-readable GLS index](https://glassesresearch.org/data/gls-index.json): Stable identifier index.

## Current research and development

- [Research & News](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/news/): Verified research/news coverage and developing research signals kept distinct.
- [Development & Hacking](https://glassesresearch.org/hacking/): SDK, API, protocol, firmware, open-hardware, and developer-resource research with evidence boundaries.
- [Reference Desk](https://glassesresearch.org/docs/REFERENCE_DESK/): Citation, source, artifact, and research-navigation resources.

## Provenance

- [Public repository](https://github.com/theGreenJedi/GlassesResearch): Source repository and review history.
- [Citation metadata](https://glassesresearch.org/CITATION.cff): Project citation metadata.

This file is a navigation index, not an alternate source of product truth. Follow the linked canonical pages and machine-readable records for current evidence state and provenance.
